    vars['Var_5'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=10.91, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_5')

    vars['Var_6'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=6.7, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_6')
